about_the_game:
Napoleonic wars meet...ducks? 

Duckoleon is calling you into battle! Barrage your opponents with cannon and musket fire, Get up close and personal with bayonets and cavalry, play military instruments like drums or the fife and much more!

GAME IS STILL EARLY IN DEVELOPMENT! THERE'S A LOT MORE CONTENT ON THE WAY, ALL OF THESE FEATURES ARE GOING TO BE AVALIABLE ON LAUNCH!

  • Mutliple nations to choose from: France, Prussia, Great Britain, Russia, Habsburg empire, and more!

  • Different soldier classes with special abilities: fusiliers, grenadiers, light infantry, cavalry ranging from lancers to dragoons, artillery, musical instruments...

  • Communication via proximity voice chat: Allows for better immersion and strategy!

  • Multiple maps inspired by the Napoleonic wars like Waterloo, Austerlitz and Liepzig!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later 64-bit (latest update)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7200U
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 620 2-Core 3.1 GHz
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1.5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later 64-bit (latest update)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core 3.60 GHz or Intel Core i5-9600K 6-Core 3.7 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon RX 5500 XT OC 8G or Nvidia GTX 1660
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1.5 GB available space

short_description: Experience (mildly) accurate historical battles from the Napoleonic era, but from the perspective of DUCKS! Duckoleon is a multiplayer FPS with strategic elements. Exciting combat with units ranging from line infantry to cavalry and artillery, historical uniforms, cutie ducks and much more!
